messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] COVERAGE VS REPLICATES
parts:
I don't think there is a best way established on this, at least not from me. If someone had some idea or done the research can comment on this.

I can tell you from my own experience pooling and doing the fisher's exact test is more stringent than not pooling and doing the logistic regression based test. As for which one of those methods is the best, I think that needs to be established. I go for more stringency usually. 

Best,
Altuna
